title: Automatically wrap lines when the card cannot be placed
goal: allows equal-width event cards to be automatically divided into rows according to the width of the container.
summary: flex-wrap defaults to nowrap. When set to wrap, if the current line cannot fit the next item, the browser will put it on a new line.
tasks: Enable Flexbox word wrapping in .session-list, retaining original card width and spacing.
Moves the third card to the second row in the 320px width preview. At a width of 720px, three cards line up.
hint: Set flex-wrap on Flexbox containers. By keeping each card a fixed width, you can clearly see when it wraps.

example.note: Articles may have multiple topic tags. When the list becomes narrower on mobile phones, the remaining tags will naturally flow to the next line.
